description: §66.3 rules 5–6 negative twin of base-type-pos: `let <k=(1 + 2)/>` infers `int`, and the inferred type is the cell's write contract — `@k = 2.5` is E-TYPE-031.
rationale: §66.3 rule 5: the own value "takes its type from its INITIALIZER"; rule 6: the BASE type (`int`); §66.1 rule 5: "Every cell and field write SHALL be type-checked against the target's declared type"; §7.5.1 position 6 / §66.20: a cell write whose value does not satisfy the target's type is E-TYPE-031. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S462 "go on the package".
